title: Reliable staffing activity and clearer allocation review
summary: Activity refreshes with saved staffing changes, and the allocation review button remains readable.
changes: Refreshes selected-night activity after shared roster reloads, including saved overtime and absences, without depending on delivery of individual realtime history events.
Rejects outdated history responses when a newer staffing refresh arrives during loading.
Shows loading, offline and retry states instead of claiming there is no activity when history has not loaded.
Uses a readable neutral disabled Review changes button, with white text on the active blue action in both light and dark appearance.
